items.headline: Kingston Lopa's 3 interceptions help California take down Syracuse 21-18
items.description: — Jaron-Keawe Sagapolutele threw for two touchdowns, and Kingston Lopa had three interceptions as California beat Syracuse 21-18 in an Atlantic Coast Conference opener for both teams Saturday.

items.headline: Steve Angeli sharp, throws for three touchdowns in return as Syracuse routs New Hampshire 66-3
items.description: — Steve Angeli passed for three touchdowns in his first game action following a season-ending injury nearly a year ago, freshman Shavane Anderson ran for three more, and Syracuse routed New Hampshire 66-3 Saturday in the Orange’s season opener.
